card.name: Grasp and other hands-on instruction verbs
card.fires_on: The verb grasp (also Grasp split as Gr-asp) at the start of a handling step in administration instructions. It also fires on shake and on area after cleanse affected.

modes.label: Grasp a device part
modes.description: Grasp begins a step telling the user to hold a part of a syringe, implant device or container.
modes.example: To administer the ZOLADEX implant and to activate the protective sleeve,<< grasp>> the barrel at the finger grip and depress

modes.label: Shake before use
modes.description: The verb shake opens an instruction to mix a suspension.
modes.example: Do not administer deflazacort oral suspension with grapefruit juice [see Drug Interactions ( 7.1 ) ] .<< Shake>> deflazacort oral suspension well

modes.label: Cleanse affected area
modes.description: The word area ends the phrase cleanse affected area in topical directions.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Cleanse the affected<< area>> gently. After the skin is dry,
